-- EFFECT MISMATCH ---------------------------------- main.fango

`caller` performs `Log`, which its annotation does not list.

12| caller : () ->{Db} Int
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

This performs it:

13| caller() = fetch()
               ^^^^^^^

The annotation says:

    () ->{Db} Int

but the body needs:

    () ->{App} Int

Note: `App` is an alias for {Db, Log}
